prompt: Design a flagship smartphone launch campaign for Aether Mobile — Bangladesh's premier technology brand. The smartphone product render must occupy at least 50% of the canvas as the undisputed hero. Primary background: Horizon Navy (#0A192F). Use Aether Breeze (#64FFDA) strictly for headline text, logo accents, and interactive highlights. Titanium White (#F8F9FA) for body copy. Slate Gray (#8892B0) for tech specs and dividers. Typography: Lora Bold for all English headlines and body, Hind Siliguri for all Bengali copy. Maximum 3 tech specifications visible. No clutter — one device, one message, one action. Campaign headline (Lora Bold, Aether Breeze): 'Capture the Unseen.' Bengali sub-headline (Hind Siliguri): 'তোমার দুনিয়া, সীমাহীন।' Sub-copy (Titanium White): 'Aether Mobile — Connect Beyond.' Tone: intelligent, elevated, proudly Bangladeshi.
